output.summary: Review 1 of 3f57ad0: not ready. No Critical. I1: a team finish record that lost to a web approval stays at its path (its hash never equals the web hash), so after a handed PR is closed unmerged any later team finish posts it without asking the PL again (breaks D48's new-answer rule). I2: run steps and the AI prompt switch the PL's own clone to the commit, carrying uncommitted edits into the check and leaving a detached HEAD. evaluation.feedback: Implement attempt 2.
